document: Form PENS.E/2-C - Payment Instructions for a Residual Settlement and Any Retroactive Benefit Due
governing_article: Article 38 of the UNJSPF Regulations and Section J.3 of the Administrative Rules

chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/2-C is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/2-C is submitted by a designated recipient of a residual settlement and/or retroactive due but unpaid benefit to provide payment instructions after a participant's or retiree's death.

chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/2-C
chunks.text: Section 1 - Deceased participant or retiree information; Section 2 - Designated recipient information (individual or institution); Section 3 - Bank account information; Section 4 - Emergency contact; Section 5 - Acknowledgement, signature and signature authentication.

chunks.heading: Acknowledgements on form PENS.E/2-C
chunks.text: The recipient confirms having read article 38 of the UNJSPF Regulations and sections B.5 and J.3 of the Administrative Rules and the form's instructions, and confirms enclosing a valid government photo ID and bank statement/document/voided cheque.
